title: K-th Largest XOR Coordinate Value

monster.name: Grid XOR Sovereign
monster.title: Master of 2D Bitwise Prefixes
monster.defeatQuote: Compute the 2D prefix XOR of all rectangular subgrids, find the k-th rank!

description: You are given a 2D integer matrix `matrix` of size `m x n` and an integer `k`. The value of coordinate `(a, b)` of the matrix is the XOR of all `matrix[i][j]` where `0 <= i <= a < m` and `0 <= j <= b < n` (0-indexed). Find the `k-th` largest value (1-indexed) of all the coordinates of `matrix`.
starterCode:
def kthLargestValue(matrix: list[list[int]], k: int) -> int:
    pass
solutionCode:
def kthLargestValue(matrix: list[list[int]], k: int) -> int:
    m, n = len(matrix), len(matrix[0])
    xor_grid = [[0] * (n + 1) for _ in range(m + 1)]
    values = []
    for i in range(1, m + 1):
        for j in range(1, n + 1):
            val = matrix[i-1][j-1] ^ xor_grid[i-1][j] ^ xor_grid[i][j-1] ^ xor_grid[i-1][j-1]
            xor_grid[i][j] = val
            values.append(val)
    values.sort(reverse=True)
    return values[k - 1]
